groups.problem: In both Create and Update, the Storage failure path calls recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: The same wrong-recorder mistake appears in the Create and Update error paths, and the fix is the same replacement in both.

groups.problem: The async legacy path in DeleteCollection records its duration with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
groups.rationale: All three point to the same line and give the same fix.

groups.problem: The Delete success path passes name instead of options.Kind as the kind label to recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: Both report the same wrong argument on line 106.

groups.problem: Delete calls klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of using the enriched log, so the per-request log values are lost.
groups.rationale: Both report the same wrong logger on line 97.

groups.problem: options.Kind and ResourceVersion are read without a nil check on options, which can cause a nil-pointer panic.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing nil guard across all the methods.

groups.problem: The async legacy writes derive their context from the request context, so they get canceled when the handler returns.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same cancellation problem and suggest context.WithoutCancel or Background.

groups.problem: The Mode3 tests never wait for the async legacy goroutine or check that the legacy mock was called.
groups.rationale: The same test gap is repeated in the Create, Update, Delete and DeleteCollection tests, and one approach (synchronize, then assert the legacy mock) fixes all of them.
